outfit.name: 萨米猎人原作衣装
outfit.prose: her original gray outer coat draped below the shoulders with pale lining and broad cuffs, a black hunter leotard with crossing chest straps and a small upper-chest cutout beneath the white-and-silver separate neck collar, layered utility belts and pouches, asymmetrical black legwear with one thigh-high stocking, white thigh straps, and broad strapped dark boots
